entries.title: Piecewise-Compensated High-PSRR Bandgap Reference
entries.desc: Bandgap reference with higher-order curvature correction in SKY130 and GPDK90. Achieves 4.4 ppm/°C TC using piecewise BJT non-ideality compensation and improved PSRR via cascode current mirrors. Full PVT corner verification.

entries.title: Folded-Cascode OTA Tapeout
entries.desc: Designed and submitted a Folded-Cascode OTA in GF180MCU-D PDK through the TinyTapeout GF180 (TTGF0P3) analog shuttle. Completed full pre-tapeout verification including DRC, LVS, and PEX extraction.

entries.title: Design of Process-Invariant Ring Amplifier using Deadzone Regulation
entries.desc: PVT-robust Ring Amplifier in IHP SG13G2 (BiCMOS). A deadzone regulation circuit with negative feedback controls third-stage quiescent current across corners. Dynamic error analysis covers RC, large-signal, and small-signal settling regimes; validated in a switched-capacitor amplifier.
entries.meta: IHP SG13G2 · Ring Amplifier · SC Amplifier · PVT Robust

entries.title: Ultra-Low Power Two-Transistor Subthreshold Voltage Reference
entries.desc: Voltage reference using native NMOS devices matching subthreshold currents between a diode-tied NMOS and a load transistor. Achieved 60 ppm/°C TC across process corners with power ≤ 2 pW.

entries.title: Low Dropout Voltage Regulator (LDO)
entries.desc: LDO in SKY130 achieving 1 µs transient settling for a 100 pF, 50 mA load with −60 dB PSRR. Integrated a digital on-chip load for transient testing and an enable switch for complete shutdown.
entries.meta: SKY130 · LDO · −60 dB PSRR · 1 µs settling

entries.title: Rail-to-Rail Input Swing OTA
entries.desc: Folded-cascode OTA in SKY130 with complementary PMOS/NMOS differential pair folding for rail-to-rail input swing. 63–64 dB DC gain, 2 MHz UGF, 85° phase margin across all PVT corners; input-referred offset μ = 0.11 mV, σ = 1.54 mV.
entries.meta: SKY130 · OTA · 64 dB gain · 85° PM · Rail-to-Rail

entries.title: 2-Stage Fully Differential OTA
entries.desc: Fully differential OTA in SKY130 with PMOS differential pair and NMOS load. Buffer-based common-mode reference stabilises output CM level for high gain and bandwidth.

entries.title: Design of Power-on Reset Circuit
entries.desc: POR circuit in SKY130 PDK using a current comparator with PMOS/NMOS current mirrors for threshold detection. VPOR asserts Enable at VDD = 1.5 V across PVT corners.
entries.meta: SKY130 · POR · PVT Corners · 1.5 V threshold

entries.title: Automation of PVT and SPICE Simulation Framework for Analog Design
entries.desc: Open-source Python tools for analog IC design automation: PVT sweep framework for NGSpice with automated metric extraction and comparison plots; SPICE-to-area estimation tool using Magic VLSI for early floorplanning before physical layout.
